items.text: DISCONNECT BATTERY CABLE FROM NEGATIVE TERMINAL

items.heading: DRAIN COOLANT
items.text: Open the radiator drain cock and drain coolant into a suitable container.

substeps.text: Loosen the adjusting nuts, and disconnect the cable housing from the bracket.
Disconnect the cable from the throttle linkage.
Disconnect the throttle cable from the engine rear end.

items.heading: RAISE VEHICLE AND DRAIN TRANSMISSION
items.caution: Be sure the vehicle is securely supported.

items.heading: DISCONNECT THREE WIRING CONNECTORS
items.text: Disconnect the three connectors located near the starter.

items.heading: REMOVE INTERMEDIATE PROPELLER SHAFT TOGETHER WITH CENTER BEARING

substeps.text: Disconnect the propeller shaft from the intermediate shaft.

items.heading: DISCONNECT EXHAUST PIPE FROM TAIL PIPE

substeps.text: Disconnect the pipe at the rear side of the converter.
Remove the pipe clamp from the transmission case.
